G1_unambiguity.justification: The dispersion condition unambiguously requires all k possible values to occur on each coordinate axis, which is equivalent to using every member of each group exactly once.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the input bounds, uniqueness condition, selection requirement, validity condition, output format, and handling of impossible instances.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Selecting k distinct catalog voxels with dispersion 3k is exactly equivalent to selecting k allowed triples that use every specialist, machine, and time slot once.

G4_naturalness.justification: The holographic framing is coherent and readable, though it is somewhat artificial compared with the original crew-based formulation.
